title: Infinix HOT 20S × PUBG Mobile
info: Special-edition packaging for the Infinix HOT 20S, co-branded with PUBG Mobile. The box had to carry two brands at once: a smartphone maker and one of the best-known mobile games.

images.alt: Infinix HOT 20S × PUBG Mobile box in shrink-wrap on a table

value.title: Challenge
paragraphs: A phone box is usually quiet and product-led. A gaming special edition needs to feel like the game itself, without losing the phone’s own name, key specs and the Infinix brand.

images.alt: Die-line of the Infinix HOT 20S × PUBG Mobile box with colour swatches on a desk

value.title: Solution
paragraphs: The lid is built around a PUBG character over Infinix teal, with the model name “HOT 20S” set large on the long edge and the key specs (120Hz FHD+ and 13GB RAM) called out as yellow game-style tags.

Every face of the box has a job: the long side carries the game’s “Winner winner chicken dinner” line with chicken and rifle icons, the end panel carries the Special Edition mark, the top flap repeats the Infinix | PUBG Mobile lock-up, and the bottom flap holds the handling and recycling symbols.
